title: CLAUDE.md Role Guide: Global vs Project + Self-Healing
title_ko: CLAUDE.md 역할 안내: 전역 vs 프로젝트 + 셀프힐링
desc: Newbie orientation and mandatory rules guide. Explains two-layer CLAUDE.md system global vs project repo root. Lists key mandatory rules English only code Korean haeyo-che responses speak not slack no process kill CDP port discipline delegate first terse. Self-healing CLAUDE.md patterns. How to create project CLAUDE.md from scratch when none exists. Must read on first session.
steps: TWO-LAYER SYSTEM: (1) Global CLAUDE.md at ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md -- applies to ALL projects, loaded first. (2) Project CLAUDE.md at repo root -- project-specific, loaded second and WINS over global on conflict.

GLOBAL CLAUDE.MD PURPOSE: tool-level universal rules that apply everywhere -- language, notifications, CDP port, process kill protection, delegation policy, suggest protocol, loop rules, secrets file. Do NOT put project-specific content here.

KEY MANDATORY RULES (memorize -- apply every session): (A) LANGUAGE: user-facing final responses = Korean polite -yo form. NEVER informal speech. Everything else = English only (code, comments, CLAUDE.md, skills, commits, docs, prompts). Non-English in code burns 2-3x tokens per session load. (B) NOTIFICATIONS: always 'wkappbot speak text --bg'. NEVER 'wkappbot slack send' -- fails silently when Slack is closed. (C) PROCESS KILL: never kill wkappbot-core.exe/wkchat.exe/wkappbot.exe directly -- route through 'wkappbot taskkill' which requires user confirmation. (D) CDP PORT: run 'wkappbot cdp open url' first, get assigned cdp:{port}, include it in every subsequent grap. Never hardcode or snoop another project port. (E) DELEGATE: default = spawn agents. Haiku for reads/surveys, codex-mini for code edits, Opus for architecture/judgment, triad for hard unknowns. Stay in orchestrator seat. (F) TERSE: responses under 80 words unless task needs detail. No preamble, no recap of what user said.
PROJECT CLAUDE.MD PURPOSE: domain knowledge for this repo only -- build commands, architecture overview, known gotchas, CWD shorthand, key file paths, gg Main Workflow section.

GG MAIN WORKFLOW SECTION (required in every project CLAUDE.md): ordered executable steps that run when user sends 'gg'. Must include skill loads, suggest triage, project-specific recurring tasks. Without this section, gg prompts Claude to create it.

SELF-HEALING WHEN TO UPDATE: update project CLAUDE.md immediately when (A) a command in it fails, (B) a new pattern is established, (C) a gotcha is discovered, (D) architecture changes. Global CLAUDE.md: update only via user request or when a universal rule is wrong.

HOW TO UPDATE: project CLAUDE.md -> Edit tool directly (it is a project file). Global CLAUDE.md -> Edit tool at ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. After editing: verify gg section runs top-to-bottom without errors.

SELF-HEALING PATTERN: at session end or after a significant fix, scan project CLAUDE.md for stale content (changed build commands, removed features, new tools). Fix inline and commit with the code change it describes.
SHARED MARKDOWN RULE: if the same subject appears in README.md and CLAUDE.md, they must agree. Update both in the same commit. Drift = wasted tokens on every future session.

NO PROJECT CLAUDE.MD YET? Create it: (1) Write the file with the template below. (2) Fill project name, build command, architecture 3 sentences. (3) Add gg Main Workflow with suggest list -> Agent triage. (4) git add CLAUDE.md and commit. MINIMUM TEMPLATE: # ProjectName -- AI Session Guide. Build: build-command. Architecture: 1-3 sentences. gg Main Workflow: 1. wkappbot skill read on-load 2. wkappbot suggest list 3. Agent(model:opus, prompt:triage INSERT-LIST) Gotchas: add as you discover them.
